source.rank: Not filled yet: rank is null until `node scripts/attach-ranks.mjs a2` attaches the French OpenSubtitles 2018 list (hermitdave/FrequencyWords fr_50k, licence to verify). Until then these words stay out of the frequency rounds.
source.lemmas: Authored for icanspeak French in the standard French of France (variety fr-FR; frCA notes where Québec usage differs), chosen by topic for CEFR A2, with what a resident of France needs first. Level banding is our own, NOT an official reference list (no Référentiel / DELF word list): the UI must not claim otherwise. gender = the singular article as the learner says it: le / la / l' / les (plural-only) / le/la (common gender); genus where l' or les hides the gender; hAspire on h aspiré nouns. IPA authored per word (standard French, syllable dots, no liaison).
